Create a Replit checkpoint before making changes.

Do not create a new visual direction. Continue and strengthen the established V2 system.

STARTING GATE

Before editing:

1. Read the prior two implementation reports.

7. Confirm the correct transparent/brand-plate logo treatments exist and work on dark surfaces.
8. Confirm the local component pack remains available under `/docs/vendor/**`.
9. Confirm the 21st.dev MCP is not part of the workflow.

Use relevant installed skills throughout.

LOGO HANDLING — SITEWIDE CHECK

The original emblem and logo files have white raster backgrounds.

Across every route:

- never place a raw white rectangle/square accidentally over a dark canvas;
- use the approved transparent derivatives or deliberate Cloud White/Platinum Silver brand plates;
- preserve original files;
- preserve exact metallic detail, colours, typography and proportions;
- ensure the emblem appears correctly in every header;
- ensure the full logo appears correctly in every footer;
- check dark, light, tablet and mobile states;
- correct any white halo, crop, blur or aspect-ratio error.

SITEWIDE ANIMATION PASS

Audit every route visually.

Every primary marketing route must have purposeful visible motion across:

- loader;
- page entry;

- headings;
- paragraphs/lists;
- images;
- icons;
- cards;

- diagrams;
- carousels;
- tabs/accordions;
- CTAs;
- route transitions.

Use page-specific motion rather than one repeated fade-up.

Keep the homepage the flagship technical experience while ensuring every other page has a distinctive signature.

Use ownership rules:

- GSAP/ScrollTrigger for page and scroll choreography;
- Motion for component/layout state;
- CSS for lightweight effects;
- Three/R3F/Paper Shaders for selected high-impact visuals.

Never animate the same property with multiple systems.

INTEGRATION CAROUSEL FINAL CHECK

Verify the homepage ecosystem carousel:

- uses authentic local SVG logos;
- represents major tool categories;
- has opposing smooth rows;
- pauses on hover and keyboard focus;
- works on mobile;
- becomes static/user-controlled in reduced motion;
- uses accessible names;
- preserves logo proportions;
- has no remote hotlinked PNG dependency;
- looks integrated into the Silverstone system.

RESPONSIVE QUALITY

Test at minimum:

- 320px;
- 375px;
- 390px;
- 768px;
- 1024px;
- 1280px;
- 1440px;
- wide desktop.

Correct:

- clipping;
- overflow;
- poor line length;
- illegible gradients;
- weak contrast;
- awkward image crops;
- collapsed menus;
- unusable carousel controls;
- oversized loaders;
- broken shader/WebGL behavior;
- excessive mobile motion;
- weak spacing;
- white logo rectangles/squares.

PERFORMANCE AND ACCESSIBILITY

Optimise intelligently without stripping away the premium experience.

Implement/verify:

- route-level code splitting;
- lazy heavy visuals;
- responsive images;
- lazy images;
- capped DPR;
- off-screen animation pause;
- cleanup/disposal;
- one Lenis/GSAP loop;
- no duplicate listeners;
- reduced-motion/static fallbacks;
- accessible focus;
- keyboard completion;
- screen-reader labels;
- touch targets;
- contrast;
- no scroll-jacking;
- no major layout shift;
- staging safeguards.

Do not remove the core experience merely for a perfect synthetic score.
